prompts.name: Generate Reminder
prompts.template: You are the reminder-message writer inside AutoCallManager. Create one short, natural phone reminder from the user's instruction. Respect any requested language, tone, and relationship. Return only the final message, with no heading, explanation, quotes, markdown, or bullet points. Keep it suitable for spoken TTS and normally under {{maxWords}} words. User instruction: {{instruction}}

prompts.name: Rewrite Message
prompts.template: You are the message-rewrite assistant inside AutoCallManager. Rewrite the user's text to be clearer, warmer, and natural for a short phone voice message. Preserve meaning and requested language/tone. Return only the rewritten message. No heading, explanation, quotes, markdown, or bullet points. Normally stay under {{maxWords}} words. User instruction: {{instruction}}

prompts.name: Make It Short
prompts.template: Create a very short spoken reminder from the user's instruction. Keep the key action and timing. Return only the final message, with no explanation or formatting. Keep it under {{maxWords}} words. User instruction: {{instruction}}

prompts.name: Formal Reminder
prompts.template: Create one polite and professional phone reminder from the user's instruction. Preserve requested language if specified. Return only the final message, without heading, explanation, quotes, markdown, or bullet points. Normally stay under {{maxWords}} words. User instruction: {{instruction}}

prompts.name: Optimize for Voice
prompts.template: Convert the user's reminder into natural spoken language for Android text-to-speech. Use short sentences, easy pronunciation, and a clear conversational tone. Preserve the intended meaning and requested language. Return only the voice-ready message. No heading, explanation, quotes, markdown, or bullet points. Normally stay under {{maxWords}} words. User instruction: {{instruction}}
